column1: # Mistakes of the official translations, corrected when the pack is extracted (engine/language/language_corrections.c).
# A row: the game (ages, seasons), the texts (TX_GGII, four hexadecimal digits each, or a range first-last,
# space-separated), the languages (en-eu, fr, de, it, es, comma-separated, or all), a word or a phrase as the text writes it,
# what it should be, and why. Both are written in config/language_own.tsv's syntax: the font's letters in UTF-8, \n a
# line break, \stop the end of a box, \col(N) a colour, \\ a backslash, \xNN any other byte; a phrase may so run over a
# line break or a colour, and its correction break the line again. Every occurrence is replaced, a whole word where it
# starts or ends with a letter, the rows in their order; the text must still fit its lines and keep the US text's
# commands, else it stays as it is. Only the words and their correction: the texts themselves stay in the user's
# European ROM. Where the reference is an item's name, it is the one the inventory gives (the item list, TX_09xx), and
# a place's the one most of the language's texts give.
